task.notes: Multi-run wireless dataset exported using the optical DT artifact pattern with per-row scenario/configuration JSON fields.

schema.row_granularity: one application flow under one ns-3 scenario variant

scenario.name: indoor-hybrid
assumptions: stock ns-3.44 has no built-in LiFi module; generated C++ must implement an idealized LiFi access link using standard ns-3 primitives without calling non-existent LiFi APIs
Must use ns-3.44 compatible API: PointToPointHelper::Install must not be passed two NodeContainers
Must use ns-3.44 compatible API: do not call Ipv4InterfaceContainer::GetInterface
3 CPEs act as multi-homed devices or separate nodes to connect to WiFi, LiFi, and LTE access points
Expanded dataset variant generated through parameter enumeration: seed=1, simTime=10.0s, offeredLoad=2.0Mbps, packetSize=1024B, mobilitySpeed=0.5m/s, lifiRate=50.0Mbps.
